scope: Read-only source and checkpoint metadata audit plus an isolated synthetic GPU1 layer-level preflight; no full-model inference and no complete checkpoint weights loaded.

dispatch_conclusions.pre_4816_default_on_gfx1201: Quark maps the checkpoint's MXFP4 weight + dynamic MXFP4 activation to kMxfp4Static x kMxfp4Dynamic. The earlier ordered candidates cannot implement that scheme on RDNA4: FlyDSL accepts only FP8 activations; RDNA3 W4A8 is restricted to gfx1100; AITER needs native-MX support and accepts MXFP4 dynamic activations. With amd-quark present, selection therefore reaches EmulationMxfp4LinearKernel (W4A4 QDQ + BF16/FP16 F.linear).
dispatch_conclusions.post_4816_default_on_gfx1201_with_flydsl: For the RDNA4 FlyDSL candidate only, when checkpoint activation is None or MXFP4 dynamic and no explicit activation override was supplied, selector substitutes per-token FP8. That gives MXFP4 weights x FP8 activations (W4A8), then chooses FlyDSL if ROCm gfx1200/gfx1201 and the FlyDSL kernel module are available.
dispatch_conclusions.dense_or_moe: The audited Qwen3.8-27B text config has no num_experts field and its card describes decoder linears; this is the dense-linear path, not an MoE expert GEMM. It is a multimodal model; vision layers are listed in quantization excludes.

Benchmark-only harness uses actual vLLM selector/apply_weights, records unsupported W4A4 paths as FlyDSL-only, and excludes weight prep from timed region.

constraints_for_matched_layer_benchmark: Force mxfp4 -> emulation for the baseline and leave checkpoint MXFP4 dynamic activation intact; force mxfp4 -> flydsl for the candidate and pass fp8_per_token explicitly (or verify the auto RDNA4 substitution log).
Build two independent layer instances from the same quantized packed weight/scales and same bias, since FlyDSL post-load preshuffles/replaces weights while emulation retains or dequantizes them.

Use identical BF16 input samples and layer N,K and token count M for both arms. Time apply_weights end-to-end for layer cost; separately time GEMM-only if useful, since both arms have activation quantization costs and those costs differ.

Warm compilation and allocator paths before timing; exclude load-time processing/weight preparation from steady-state latency. Synchronize with HIP events or use equivalent graph replay for small decode M. Report M values, dtype, TP-sharded N/K, warm/cold cache protocol, repeats and percentile/median.

Compare each arm to its own arithmetic reference. Outputs are not expected to match exactly across W4A4 and W4A8 activation quantization; report output error between them separately. Keep output dtype, input tensor, weight checkpoint, TP partition, bias, and graph mode fixed.

FlyDSL supports gfx1200/gfx1201 ROCm with installed flydsl.kernels.gemm.rdna4_mxfp4, packed [N,K/2] uint8 weights, [N,K/32] uint8 E8M0 scales, K multiple of 32 and positive N/K; kernel output is BF16 or FP16. Selector backend constraints and exact model layer partition still need run-time confirmation.

The `VLLM_MXFP4_EMULATION_DEQUANT_AT_LOAD` environment setting changes baseline timing/memory semantics; leave it unset/false to test the default per-call dequant path, or report it explicitly as a separate arm.
Do not treat the FlyDSL native FP8-vs-FP8 kernel microbenchmark as a matched W4A4 serving comparison; it excludes FP4 and activation quantization differences.

The installed Quark emulation QDQ implementation additionally requires M*K divisible by 64, and its weight-decode implementation requires N*K divisible by 512. Shapes failing either must remain explicit emulation-unsupported rows; benchmark FlyDSL alone for those and do not report a W4A4-vs-W4A8 speedup.

The harness CPU-reference path decodes sampled packed E2M1 weights with an independent OCP lookup table, quantizes the full activation tensor before sampling rows, validates each backend against its own quantization reference, and reports cross-backend error separately.

The GPU1 preflight used synthetic packed weights, including the cached checkpoint layer dimensions N=17408,K=5120; it did not load the cached checkpoint tensor. The real layer can be requested with --weights and --weight-key for a separate run.

runtime_preflight.selector_observation: The current init_mxfp4_linear_kernel selector, called with kMxfp4Dynamic, selected EmulationMxfp4LinearKernel under an explicit emulation backend and Rdna4Mxfp4LinearKernel under gfx1201 auto dispatch; the latter config carries kFp8DynamicTokenSym. This validates current selector behavior, not execution of the historical pre-FlyDSL server build.
